label: Hangop
note: Traditionally from buttermilk, today mostly yoghurt; not Jan-in-de-zak

about.text: Hangop is a Dutch dessert made from buttermilk or yoghurt that is hung in a cloth to drain overnight, leaving a thick, quark-like mass. It is easy to make at home and is now also made in factories.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Fermented milk is poured into a clean tea towel and left to drip; no heat, rennet or starter.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.name: drain
steps.note: Poured into a clean tea towel and left to drip for one night, hung or over a dish.
